name: kabeuchi
description: A sounding-board session that grows a picture-first, one-page artifact with a reader who cannot yet picture the subject — a task, a question or a choice, in this codebase or outside it — until they say it has come together; then asks once whether to hand off to a /mobpro or /dev-workflow run, ending with the two --resume lines on yes or the page URL on no. Requires the artifactor plugin, which draws the page
